reason: Tata Motors has launched a voluntary tender offer for all common shares of Iveco Group at a fixed price of €14.40 per share.
why_now: The offer was formally announced and the price finalized on October 9, 2026, creating a near-term arbitrage opportunity between the current market price and the tender offer price.
source_headlines: Tata Motors Limited: Tata Motors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 09, 2026, titled "TML CV Holdings B.V., an Indirect Wholly Owned Subsidiary of Tata Motors Limited (formerly TML Commercial Vehicles Limited) Voluntary TotalitarianTender Offer for all the common shares of Iveco Group N.V.".
